text: A rectangle has sides of length $a$ and $36$. A hinge is installed at each vertex of the rectangle, and at the midpoint of each side of length $36$. The sides of length $a$ can be pressed toward each other keeping those two sides parallel so the rectangle becomes a convex hexagon as shown. When the figure is a hexagon with the sides of length $a$ parallel and separated by a distance of $24$, the hexagon has the same area as the original rectangle. Find $a^2$.
figure: Two drawings side by side, with no labels or lengths. On the left is the rectangle, taller than it is wide: its short top and bottom sides are the sides of length a, and its long left and right sides are the sides of length 36. On the right is the convex hexagon made from it: the top and bottom sides (length a) are still horizontal and parallel but closer together, and each of the left and right sides has bent outward at its midpoint, so the hexagon has a pointed vertex at the far left and one at the far right.
